items.headline: Council to consider leasing city-owned Stevens Creek property
items.summary: The City Council is scheduled to consider a proposed approach for leasing the city-owned commercial property at 22100 Stevens Creek Boulevard.

items.headline: Santa Clara reviews Benton-Brokaw crossing study, station area plan
items.summary: The Station Area Task Force's October 15 agenda included a public hearing on the Benton-Brokaw Multimodal Crossing Feasibility Study and a review of the complete draft Station Area Specific Plan.

items.headline: Ten new single-family home permits issued on Aldeia Drive
items.summary: The city issued 10 new-construction permits for single-family homes along Aldeia Dr, with declared permit valuations ranging from $424,925 to $641,692 across different house plans. One permit, for 'Lot 14' at 5 Aldeia Drive, lists 2 dwelling units in the source data though the permit is categorized as single-family.

items.headline: Parking lot at 1870 Embarcadero Road approved for 10 EV stalls
items.summary: An over-the-counter architectural review was approved to modify an existing parking lot at 1870 Embarcadero Road to add 10 EV charging stalls; this is a planning approval, not a building permit for construction.

items.headline: Peery Park plan may add offices, R&D, housing
items.summary: The October 12 Planning Commission special meeting agenda listed a study session and scoping meeting on amending the Peery Park Specific Plan to increase office and R&D square footage and residential units, and to relocate the Libby Water Tower, along with public comment on a Notice of Preparation for a Supplemental EIR to the 2016 plan's environmental review.
